None of these point estimates represent a dramatic directional call — they are closer to a "slight lean higher" than a strong conviction view.

By one week, the interval broadens to roughly plus or minus 14.5 points, capturing intra-week volatility and the possibility of macro data releases or sentiment shifts. By one month, the interval of 298 to 358 — a range of 60 points — reflects the accumulation of many potential shocks, regime changes, and compounding uncertainty that makes medium-term forecasting inherently imprecise.
